raw.details:
ML.ai

  • At the intersection of machine learning and intelligent systems, ML.ai represents the pursuit of advancing AI capabilities and exploring new possibilities through experimentation, innovation, and intelligent technology.

Infrasity

  • Infrasity is a developer marketing and technical storytelling company connecting technology brands with developer communities through content, community, and strategic engagement. Infrasity brings builders, innovators, and emerging technologies closer together.

The Collaboration

Where Intelligence Meets Innovation.

INFRA//SHIFT is a 8-hour AI hackathon bringing together developers, AI enthusiasts, students, and working professionals to explore what comes next in intelligent technology.

More than a competition, it is a space for experimentation, collaboration, and building solutions that move beyond conventional boundaries.

One day. Eight hours. Infinite possibilities.

Event Details

  • Date: 14 November 2026
  • Duration: 8 Hours
  • Venue: infrasity Office, Janakpuri West, New Delhi, India
  • Eligibility: open to All — Students & Working Professionals
  • Team Size: 1–4 Members per Team

Themes

01 — Autonomous Ai Agents

Build Intelligent Systems Capable of Reasoning, Planning, and Executing Tasks with Minimal Human Intervention.

02 — Multi-Agent Orchestration

Design Collaborative Ai Ecosystems Where Multiple Agents Coordinate, Communicate, and Solve Complex Problems Together.

03 — Trustworthy & Secure Ai

Engineer Intelligent Solutions Grounded in Security, Reliability, Transparency, Privacy, and Responsible Ai.

04 — Open Innovation

Break Beyond Predefined Boundaries. Identify Meaningful Challenges and Build Technology-Driven Solutions with Real-World Potential.

Judging Criteria

Projects Will Be Evaluated by An Expert Jury Based On:

  • Innovation & Originality: uniqueness, Creativity, and Differentiation.
  • Technical Implementation: technical Quality, Functionality, and Effective Use of Ai.
  • Real-World Impact: problem Relevance, Scalability, and Practical Value.
  • Execution & Prototype: working Prototype, Completeness, and Implementation.
  • Presentation & Demo: clarity, Demonstration Quality, and Communication.

Support & Resources

Participants Will Have Access to Expert Mentorship, Technical Assistance, and Ai Resources to Support Their Development Journey. Get Guidance, Troubleshoot Challenges, and Leverage Ai Credits to Turn Innovative Ideas Into Functional Solutions.

Rules & Regulations

  • Open to Students and Working Professionals.
  • Teams Must Consist of 1–4 Members.
  • Open-Source Tools, Ap Is, and Ai Models Are Permitted with Proper Attribution.
  • Plagiarism or Misrepresentation Will Result in Disqualification.
  • Teams Must Submit Their Projects Within the Specified Deadline.
  • Participants Must Follow Venue Policies and Organizer Instructions.
  • Participants Must Bring Their Own Laptops and Required Equipment.
  • Participants Must Bring Their Own Extention Boards
  • Judges' Decisions Will Be Final.

The Challenge

Think Beyond Prompts.
Build Beyond Possibilities.
Create beyond expectations.
